items.reason: This is the mattifying gel you asked for, and it gives a softer, less shiny finish with a light feel.
A gentle, non-stripping cleanser keeps your skin feeling clean without adding to any tight, dry feeling.
Your moisture score looks low on the scan, so a light hydrating serum under the gel adds water-based comfort without making skin look shinier.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides blends well on deeper skin tones and protects your skin during the day.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, apply the hyaluronic serum to slightly damp skin, follow with the mattifying gel, then finish with SPF. Evening: cleanse, then the serum and gel again, and reapply SPF through the day if you are outdoors.
